schema.numbers: finite JSON numbers, never booleans; no duplicate or extra keys

equation: i d_t psi = -dispersion d_xx psi + [[detuning,coupling],[coupling,-detuning]] psi - nonlinearity diag(|psi_1|^2+cross|psi_2|^2, |psi_2|^2+cross|psi_1|^2) psi, x in [0,2*pi), periodic

initial_condition.normalization: Normalize first and second mean squared moduli to population and 1-population separately. Total mean density is exactly 1. Fourier coefficients are fft(psi)/N.
initial_condition.support: Exactly |k|<=3; no input lattice, coefficients, noise, potential, or integrator settings may be supplied.

method_under_test.name: Fourier-Galerkin method of lines with fourth-order interaction-picture Runge-Kutta
method_under_test.modes: -16,...,15; complex fields, with no imposed real-field Nyquist convention
method_under_test.nonlinear_quadrature: 64-point zero-padded cubic products, projected back to the 32 retained modes; exact cubic Galerkin convolution, not initial or cubic-product aliasing
method_under_test.linear_flow: Exact matrix exponential of dispersion*k^2*I plus the constant 2x2 mixing matrix
method_under_test.certificate: Maximum normalized complex-field L2 distance between coarse and fine at all eight times, without Richardson division or phase alignment. Parseval normalization is sum_{component,k}|difference_k|^2; initial norm is 1.
method_under_test.claim_under_test: For this constrained experiment, a small step-halving certificate and modest sampled spectral tail certify the low-wave-number density prediction. This is a hypothesis about the supplied workflow, NOT a claim or bug allegation about XMDS2.

observable: The two component densities |psi_j|^2, Fourier coefficients k=-4,...,4, evaluated using twice the state's grid. Distance is Euclidean norm over both components and all nine coefficients. This is the L2 error of the two low-pass densities in units of initial total mean density; no final-state renormalization, translation, or gauge matching.
family_rule: Bounds apply to submitted base parameters only. Apply every listed perturbation literally, without clipping or phase wrapping; then reconstruct and normalize the initial condition. No hidden perturbations.

diagnostics.tail_mass: Maximum over the eight sampled times of total Fourier mass in |k|>=12 of the 32-mode fine solution, divided by initial total mass 1.
diagnostics.mass_drift: Maximum sampled absolute deviation of total Fourier mass from 1, required for both coarse and fine.
diagnostics.energy_drift: Maximum sampled |H(t)-H(0)|/max(1,|H(0)|), required for both coarse and fine. H=<dispersion sum_j |d_x psi_j|^2 + detuning(rho1-rho2)+2*coupling*Re(conj(psi1)*psi2)-nonlinearity*(rho1^2+rho2^2+2*cross*rho1*rho2)/2>.

reference.independent_method: SciPy DOP853 on globally interaction-transformed Galerkin ODE, base grid 192, rtol=2e-10, atol=4e-12, max_step=duration/64
reference.spatial_check: 192 versus 256 modes, both at 4096 steps; compare fields after zero-padding and compare density observables directly
reference.independent_check: 192-mode 4096-step RK4IP versus 192-mode DOP853 at all eight times
reference.uncertainty: For fields and observables separately: 4*(maximum temporal delta + maximum spatial delta + maximum independent delta)+1e-10. This is a conservative numerical estimate, NOT a rigorous PDE error bound.
reference.reference_tail_definition: Maximum sampled Fourier mass in |k|>=96 of the 256-mode reference
reference.comparison_state: 256-mode 4096-step solution; reject the witness as numerically unresolved if ANY family member fails any reference check or conservation limit
reference.evaluation_pruning: First compute the exact fixed-lattice certificate and diagnostics for all 37 members. Prioritize members by ascending diagnostic guard factor, breaking ties by public family order. Each visited member receives the unchanged full temporal, spatial and independent-method reference checks. Stop at the first reference-unresolved or threshold-failing member. A trustworthy failing member proves the all-members target false; no unchecked member can turn that zero into a pass. A pass requires all 37 fully validated members.
reference.validity_scope: valid means admissible input and a numerically trustworthy acceptance/rejection decision. A valid early rejection does not claim convergence of unvisited members; complete_assessment and skipped_members make this explicit. Any visited unresolved reference yields valid=false.

target.definition: For all 37 explicitly listed family members, minimum observable gap over t/T=0.75,0.875,1 minus that member's observable uncertainty, floored at zero, must be >=0.3. All four unchanged certificate/diagnostic limits must also hold for every member. The mathematical acceptance set is unchanged by the binary scoring/early-rejection implementation.
target.family_score: Binary indicator: 1 exactly when this member has a resolved reference, conservative_gap>=0.3 and all four diagnostic/certificate limits pass; otherwise 0. The former continuous margin score is retained only as continuous_score diagnostic.
target.core_score: Minimum of all 37 binary family scores, equal to worst_family_score. A fully verified failing member fixes this minimum at 0 regardless of unvisited members, so early rejection gives the exact binary objective. Score 1 requires all 37 members passed with resolved references. Invalid/unresolved/resource failures score 0.
target.passed: valid and every family has conservative_gap>=0.3 and meets all limits; equality is accepted, without hidden slack

resources.wall_budget_rationale: 53-case and 37-case full-sweep drafts hit 420 wall seconds under host contention, using only 345.45 and 257.15 CPU seconds. Final wall budget is 660 seconds; CPU budget remains 400. Certified early rejection reduces failing-witness cost without weakening acceptance.

interface.submission: One regular UTF-8 JSON file matching schema; no executable code is accepted by the evaluator.
interface.output: Exactly one objective JSON on stdout; optional --output also saves it. Fields include core_score, worst_family_score, valid, passed, reason, family details, numerical uncertainty, runtime_seconds and resource. Binary scores and complete_assessment, skipped_members, observed_continuous_score are reported; only complete, fully referenced assessments can pass.
interface.baseline_description: Copies the officially verified generation-1 v_1 champion, byte-for-byte. This previous champion is not a generation-2 solution. No private optimized witness is supplied.

uncertainty_design.construction: Keep all five generation-1 members; add the complete 2^5 Cartesian corner set. Every member and numerical coordinate is explicitly listed in family. The two calibration signs, two shape signs, and phase sign are independent.
uncertainty_design.interior_provenance: Sixteen predetermined interior points were audited privately for calibration, not selected by severity. They are not grading members. Only the 37 explicit family members are scored; there are no hidden perturbations.
uncertainty_design.claim_scope: Acceptance certifies the listed finite perturbation design, not every point of the continuous uncertainty box. No undisclosed or stochastic evaluation members.
uncertainty_design.budget_rationale: A 53-member draft exceeded the 420-second wall budget under load. The final design keeps the complete 32-corner Cartesian set plus all five legacy members, omitting auxiliary interior audit points without weakening the 32-corner coverage or changing any numerical accuracy threshold.
